'''R7-Z0''' was an [[R7-series astromech droid]]. The droid was primarily colored white, with a black dome and yellow-green access panels.

==Behind the scenes==
R7-Z0 has been immortalized in the ''Star Wars: Legacy "Build-A-droid" Collection''. Found on the reverse of certain Legacy figure cards are five component parts that can be used to build four different Astromech droids, with R7-Z0 being one of them. The Legacy figures that contain these parts are: [[Ak-rev/Legends|Ak-rev]] (left leg), [[Yarna d'al' Gargan/Legends|Yarna d'al' Gargan]] (right leg), [[Bane Malar/Legends|Bane Malar]] (main body), and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] (head and middle leg).
